prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: five separated texture pieces for an articulated web mascot, truly transparent RGBA. References: image 1 is the APPROVED Hito identity/proportions in resting poses; image 2 is the original SEDIPRO owl anatomy. Preserve that exact purple owl, big WHITE eye masks, purple irises with black pupils and bright white glints, purple ear tufts, friendly yellow beak, royal-blue collared SEDIPRO polo, purple rounded lower body/thighs, SHORT yellow ankles and SMALL yellow bird feet with black claws. The finished assembled owl must have the reference proportions: head about 40% of total height, blue torso about 36%, purple lower body/thighs about 14%, exposed yellow ankle/feet only about 10%. No giant head, no long yellow legs, no huge feet.
Create ONE landscape image of exactly FIVE detached components arranged in ONE horizontal row, left to right, with generous transparent gaps and no touching. All components share a softly shaded 3D toy render style, same lighting, matching absolute scale, facing screen-RIGHT in a mild three-quarter SIDE VIEW suitable for a normal walk. Components: 1) LEFT: Hito's whole head + BLUE SHIRT TORSO + small PURPLE PELVIS/BELLY + short tail, absolutely NO ARMS and NO LEGS attached. Keep tiny white SEDIPRO mark on the chest. Smooth closed shoulder areas where separate arms will overlap; rounded short pelvis where thighs will overlap. 2) A detached NEAR ARM hanging down: short blue polo sleeve at the shoulder cap, purple rounded feather arm, friendly purple feather hand with fingers pointing down; not a fist, not a raised arm. 3) The matching FAR ARM, also hanging down, slightly darker and a little smaller for depth. 4) The detached NEAR LEG: a SHORT thick rounded PURPLE THIGH (the purple part is over half of the entire leg length) tapering into a VERY SHORT yellow ankle, then a small flat yellow bird foot pointing screen-right, three black claws. This is an entire short owl leg including the purple thigh, NOT a detached long yellow boot. 5) The matching FAR LEG, slightly darker, same small anatomy and facing right.
Body component substantially taller than all other pieces; arm components roughly 32% of the reconstructed whole owl's height; full leg components roughly 24% of whole owl height. The lower yellow feet/ankles must stay short and compact like the reference. Entire components inside image, no cropping. Do not draw an assembled full-body owl; draw the FIVE distinct components. No labels, grid, diagrams, motion lines, ground, shadows outside the pieces, halos, background colors or gradients. Preserve actual transparency.
